items.source:
Add more handlers that will share the same configuration (interceptors, SockJS
config, etc).
items.translation: 添加更多将共享相同配置（拦截器、SockJS 配置等）的处理器。

items.source: Configure interceptors for the handshake request.
items.translation: 配置握手请求的拦截器。
启用 SockJS 回退选项。

items.source: By default, no origins are allowed. When allowedOriginPatterns is also set, then that takes precedence over this property.
items.translation: 默认情况下，不允许任何源。当同时设置`allowedOriginPatterns`时，该属性优先于此属性。

items.source:
Note when SockJS is enabled and origins are restricted, transport types
that do not allow to check request origin (Iframe based transports) are
disabled. As a consequence, IE 6 to 9 are not supported when origins are
restricted.
items.translation: 注意：当启用 SockJS 并限制源时，不允许检查请求源的传输类型（基于 iframe 的传输）将被禁用。因此，当限制源时，不支持 IE 6 到 9。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source: Alternative to setAllowedOrigins(String...) that supports more flexible patterns for specifying the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 作为 `setAllowedOrigins(String...)` 的替代方案，它支持更灵活的模式来指定浏览器允许跨域请求的来源。

items.source: Provides methods for configuring a WebSocket handler.
items.translation: 提供配置 WebSocket 处理器的方法。

items.source: Set the origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed from a browser.
items.translation: 设置允许浏览器发起跨域请求的源。
